``selector-config-v1.json`` cut it. R-02.9's amendment offered it, R-02.49's provider
abstraction is scoped to generation, and *"embedding"* occurs exactly once in the whole

missing-load-call shape, so the contract refuses the mode and this enum has no row for
it.

WspEndpointWindowIfReadFails.description:
``window_if_read_fails`` (``wsp/endpoints.py:window_if_read_fails``). ``source`` ``waits``
with ``tokens`` 0 (no window) for a miServer endpoint that states none (2026-11-27): a run
whose read fails waits, then fails ``editor_not_resident``; no window is assumed. For a
generic endpoint the two fields are the case of a server that ANSWERS without a window, and
``no_answer`` (operator decision D1, 2026-11-27) the case of one that gives no answer at all:
``stated``, ``waits`` (then ``editor_not_resident``) or ``not_read`` (hosted).

description: GENERATED from miForge's registered routes (their response declarations, through FastAPI's OpenAPI document); do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `PYTHONPATH=backend/src:backend python backend/scripts/generate_output_schemas.py --write`; the writer refuses a breaking change, which needs miforge-answers-v2.json beside this file. Keys of `responses` are '<METHOD> <path>'; each value maps a 2xx status to that answer's JSON body schema (health also declares its 503), `x-no-body` lists a status that answers no body beside them, and `x-media-alternatives` names each other media type a JSON route can answer and the request that selects it. `required` lists every field a route always sends; extra keys are allowed. `excluded` lists each route with no JSON body, with its media type and why. `coverage` counts the `responses` entries whose every body is typed (`typed`) or not (`untyped`), the body schemas with more than one alternative (`unions`), the entries that reference a published document (`external`), and the `excluded` routes. The one exception to 'required means always sent': an approval's stored `result` is checked in its HISTORY FORM. Each variant keeps its model's properties and types but has no `required` at any depth, because a stored row can predate a field. The variant is chosen by `action`; an action that is no longer listed leaves `result` unconstrained.
